verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a datacenter AI/HPC accelerator. Its documentation covers ROCm, HIP, vLLM/SGLang inference, Kubernetes operators and cluster tooling, so consumer gaming features such as DLSS/FSR upscaling and frame generation in games are outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows the part ships any gaming upscaling or frame-generation capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a gamer, AI upscaling and frame generation are supported on this card — the DLSS or FSR generation is documented for this part, with broad game support
